claims.claim: On Monday the CFTC approved a final rule setting an alternate reporting framework for certain fully collateralized event contracts, replacing staff no-action letters in place since 2017.

claims.supporting_quote: The final rule sets forth an alternate framework for the reporting of data in connection with certain fully collateralized event contracts, which have been the subject of staff no-action letters since 2017.

claims.claim: Chairman Michael S. Selig said the CFTC will no longer regulate market participants through a patchwork of no-action letters, which serve as band-aids for unworkable regulations.

claims.claim: A position in these event contracts becomes reportable at 125,000 one-dollar contracts, or $125,000 notional, versus a default of 25 contracts for other commodities.

claims.claim: The CFTC declined to extend the reporting framework to margined event contracts after Kalshi argued they share the features of fully collateralized contracts.

claims.supporting_quote: The CFTC declined to widen the definition and said it would revisit reporting if and when an exchange lists margined event contracts.

claims.claim: Staff said bitcoin, ether and payment stablecoins may count toward 12 months of operating costs, with minimum haircuts of 20 percent on bitcoin and ether and 2 percent on payment stablecoins, but not toward the liquidity requirement.

claims.supporting_quote: Staff would not object to a minimum 20% haircut on bitcoin and ether and 2% on payment stablecoins, the levels it already accepts for futures brokers' capital.

claims.claim: Kalshi and co-founders Tarek Mansour and Luana Lopes Lara face 14 criminal charges in Utah, which remain allegations.

claims.claim: A 2010 Journal of the Royal Statistical Society paper finds that any non-trivial weighted average of two or more distinct calibrated probability forecasts is uncalibrated and lacks sharpness.

claims.claim: A 2023 arXiv paper argues that tests comparing forecast-combination strategies can have low power and lack size control because the test statistic has a non-standard asymptotic distribution.
claims.supporting_quote: We show that this poor performance is due to the behavior of the corresponding test statistic, which has a non-standard asymptotic distribution under the null hypothesis of no inferior predictive accuracy, rather than the {standard normal distribution that is} {typically adopted}.
